verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents first-party agent tooling. AgentOS bundles pre-built skills (contract-to-billing, card provisioning, cashflow management) and a hosted remote MCP server that runs 'multi-step financial workflows on your behalf.' It also ships product-native scheduled automation through recurring invoices and multi-frequency subscriptions. However, the AgentOS workflows run inside an external agent client rather than as automations configured and executed in the background by Airwallex, and the CLI's 'wire Airwallex into automated systems' and webhooks are only building blocks. missing for 10: a native automation/rules builder for setting up triggers or schedules, documented unattended background execution of agent workflows, independent hands-on corroboration.
